Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: The plan includes an inventory of all district facilities with details on building systems such as HVAC, fire alarms, and security upgrades across multiple campuses (Ch.1-3). It identifies modernization needs and infrastructure replacements, indicating a comprehensive condition assessment beyond basic deficiencies.

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: The plan references accommodating additional grade levels (Pre-K) and expanding classrooms but lacks detailed enrollment projections, capacity utilization data, or explicit connection of enrollment trends to facility actions (Ch.1, 2).

Educational Alignment.justification: The plan connects facility projects to educational goals such as STEAM labs, enrichment programs, and Pre-K expansions, with specific projects for flexible learning spaces and program relocations (Ch.1-3). However, it lacks a fully comprehensive educational specifications section.

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: The plan includes outdoor area improvements with greening and shade structures at multiple sites, referencing outdoor learning spaces and wellness benefits, though not districtwide or fully detailed (Ch.2-3).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: The plan acknowledges HVAC replacements and shade structures which may relate to climate resilience but does not provide a detailed climate risk assessment or comprehensive mitigation strategies (Ch.1-3).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: The plan mentions HVAC replacements and some energy-related upgrades but lacks detailed energy use data, comprehensive energy resilience strategies, or references to state requirements like Title 24 or Zero Net Energy goals (Ch.1-3).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: The plan presents detailed cost estimates with escalation assumptions, a clear prioritization framework addressing safety, modernization, and program expansion, and outlines funding sources including bonds and state funds with cash balances (Ch.2-3).
